// diagnostic

E0201

The move marker `^` is required; value can't be copied

What

The move marker `^` is required; value can't be copied

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0201

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0201: tests/ui/expiring_secret_loan_escape.stderr.

Error [E0201]: an ExpiringSecret loan cannot escape its callback
  --> tests/ui/expiring_secret_loan_escape.jet:11:17
    |
 11 |     _ := secret.with((borrowed) -> borrowed)
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: the callback receives a temporary read-only loan; returning a secret would create another owned credential outside the expiry boundary
 Fix: return a non-secret result such as a signature, public key, status, or response
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0201

Error [E2402]: `?` can't convert `Expired` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> tests/ui/expiring_secret_loan_escape.jet:11:17
    |
 11 |     _ := secret.with((borrowed) -> borrowed)
    |                 ^^^^
 Why: `?` uses the declared conversion rail; `Expired` can reach `Err` only through `impl Expired -> Err`
 Fix: add `impl Expired -> Err { … }` before this function, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402
